input.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero.superhero s
JOIN superhero.publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN superhero.hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superhero.superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
